#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int MOD = 1000000007;
const int N = 1 << 20;
int modpow(int a, int b) {
  int res = 1;
  while (b) {
    if (b & 1) res = (1LL * res * a) % MOD;
    a = (1LL * a * a) % MOD;
    b >>= 1;
  }
  return res;
}
const int M = 21;
int n;
int f[N], g[N];
int prob[M][M];
int idx_left[N], idx_right[N];
int rev[N];
int matched[M];
int adj[M][M];

  vector<pair<int,int>> edges;
  for (int x : left)
    for (int y : right)
      edges.emplace_back(x, y);
  int esz = edges.size();
  for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << esz); ++mask) {
    int rate = 1;
    int newmask = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < esz; ++i) {
      int u = edges[i].first, v = edges[i].second;
      if (mask & (1 << i)) {
        rate = (1LL * rate * prob[u][v]) % MOD;
        adj[u][v] = 1;
      } else {
        rate = (1LL * rate * (1 - prob[u][v])) % MOD;
        adj[u][v] = 0;
      }
      rate = (rate + MOD) % MOD;
    }
    for (int gr : subgraphs) {
      vector<int> perm, indices;
      for (int x : left) perm.push_back(x);
      for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
        if (gr & (1 << i))
          indices.push_back(i + n);
      bool found = false;
      sort(indices.begin(), indices.end());
      do {
        bool ok = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)perm.size(); ++i)
          if (!adj[perm[i]][indices[i]]) { ok = false; break; }
        if (ok) { found = true; break; }
      } while (next_permutation(indices.begin(), indices.end()));
      if (found) newmask |= (1 << idx[gr]);
    }
    dp[newmask] = (dp[newmask] + rate) % MOD;
  }
}

    }

  int cnt1 = 0, cnt2 = 0;
  vector<int> sub1, sub2;
  for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
    if (__builtin_popcount(mask) == m1) { idx_left[mask] = cnt1++; sub1.push_back(mask); }
    if (__builtin_popcount(mask) == m2) { idx_right[mask] = cnt2++; sub2.push_back(mask); }
  }
  for (int i = 0; i < (int)sub2.size(); ++i) {

  for (int i = 0; i < m1; ++i) l1.push_back(i);
  for (int i = m1; i < n; ++i) l2.push_back(i);
